summary: This infobox-style note is the wiki entry for Rachel Berry, a character on the television series Glee. It lists her creators, the actress who plays her, her first and last appearances, her occupations and roles, her family, her romantic relationships, and her religion and nationality. The note is a short summary of biographical details rather than a full character history.
one_line: Rachel Berry is a fictional Glee character, created by Ryan Murphy, Brad Falchuk and Ian Brennan and played by Lea Michele.
key_facts: Rachel Berry is a character on the television series Glee.
Rachel Berry was created by Ryan Murphy, Brad Falchuk and Ian Brennan.
Rachel Berry is portrayed by Lea Michele.
Rachel Berry's first appearance was in the episode 'Pilot'.
Rachel Berry's last appearance is listed as the episode 'Dreams Come True'.
Rachel Berry's occupations are listed as actress and singer.
Rachel Berry's former roles include high school student, college student, waitress and co-director of the glee club.
Rachel Berry's fathers are listed as Hiram Berry and LeRoy Berry.
Rachel Berry's biological mother is Shelby Corcoran.
Rachel Berry's adoptive sister is Beth Corcoran.
Rachel Berry's spouse is Jesse St. James.
Rachel Berry's ex-fiancé Finn Hudson is listed as deceased.
Rachel Berry's listed ex-boyfriends are Brody Weston, Noah Puckerman and Sam Evans.
Rachel Berry is listed as Jewish and American.
